title: Monthly rent due reminder
description: Remind tenants that rent is due with amount, date and payment link. A utility WhatsApp template for landlords and property managers.
notes: Do not include late fee threats; state the amount and due date plainly. Send 3 days before the first of the month.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, rent of *{{amount}}* for {{unit}} is due on {{due_date}}. You can pay online in a few clicks.
